# hyperlite_resource_pool (Data Source)

A pool of VMs, to give rights on it (`hyperlite_acl`) or back it up (`hyperlite_backup_job`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_resource_pool" "web" {
  name = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The pool's name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Its description.
- `id` (String) Its id.
- `vms` (Set of String) Its VMs, by name.
